score_note: Provisional screening scores use the same 100-point rubric: CMS/content/editorial fit (20), architecture/reuse (15), maintenance (15), security/dependencies (15), docs/tests (10), license clarity (10), setup/deployment (5), APIs/integrations (5), Arabic/RTL (5). They are not measured quality, security, cost, or adoption ratings. Directus is included as a source-available comparison candidate, not an OSI-approved open-source candidate. Joomla's corrected score is the sum of its component points.

records.name: Wagtail
records.cms_type: Django editorial CMS with optional decoupled/headless delivery
records.content_model: Typed Django models and StreamField JSON blocks; drafts, revisions, permissions and editorial workflows.
records.api_headless: REST API v2 read-only; v3 authenticated CMS operations/OpenAPI 3.1 is under active development; draft preview is incomplete per supplied docs.
records.maintenance_security: v8.0 published 2026-08-25; quarterly feature-release policy and published 2026 advisories. Check patched versions and Django dependencies.
records.arabic_rtl: Historical Arabic translation/RTL work is evidenced, but current completeness and full RTL behavior remain unverified.
records.license_notes: Permissive commercial reuse subject to retaining notices/disclaimers; review each dependency and plugin separately.
records.score_breakdown: 19/20 CMS fit; 14/15 architecture; 14/15 maintenance; 10/15 security; 9/10 docs/tests; 10/10 license; 3/5 operations; 4/5 APIs; 2/5 Arabic/RTL.

records.name: WordPress
records.cms_type: Traditional editorial/publishing CMS with optional REST-based decoupling
records.license: GitHub API reports GPL-2.0; WordPress.org describes WordPress as GPL-licensed.
records.content_model: Posts, pages, taxonomies, metadata/custom post types; drafts, schedules, revisions, roles, media and comments via block editor.
records.api_headless: REST API exposes JSON for built-in content; custom routes/content can extend delivery.
records.maintenance_security: 7.1.3 announced 2026-10-06 with security fixes; security policy describes supported versions. Assess each plugin/theme independently.
records.arabic_rtl: Translation infrastructure is documented, but Arabic completeness and actual RTL behavior across admin/editor/theme/plugins were not verified.
records.license_notes: Exact LICENSE content could not be extracted in research; verify pinned file and components before redistribution. Hosted offerings, plugins, trademarks and extensions may have separate terms.
records.score_breakdown: 19/20 CMS fit; 13/15 architecture; 14/15 maintenance; 10/15 security; 9/10 docs/tests; 8/10 license; 4/5 operations; 5/5 APIs; 2/5 Arabic/RTL.

records.name: Strapi
records.cms_type: Structured headless CMS with editorial admin
records.license: Community Edition outside ee/ is MIT Expat subject to root-license conditions; ee/ components have separate supplemental/subscription/cloud terms.
records.content_model: Collection/single types, reusable components, dynamic zones, relations, Draft & Publish and i18n; review workflows/content history have paid-plan boundaries in supplied findings.
records.api_headless: Generated REST; optional GraphQL plugin; permissions and operation limits require configuration.
records.maintenance_security: v5.53.0 dated 2026-09-09; stable v5 policy and five 2026 advisories were observed. Map selected version to fixes.
records.arabic_rtl: Localization documented; Arabic availability in target build and genuine RTL admin/editor layout unverified.
records.license_notes: Pin commit/package paths and review exact community-versus-EE entitlement and signed service/subscription terms.
records.score_breakdown: 18/20 CMS fit; 14/15 architecture; 14/15 maintenance; 10/15 security; 8/10 docs/tests; 9/10 license; 3/5 operations; 5/5 APIs; 1/5 Arabic/RTL.

records.name: Umbraco CMS
records.cms_type: .NET traditional editorial CMS with optional Content Delivery API
records.license: MIT core; commercial cloud, closed-source add-ons and third-party packages separate.
records.content_model: Document/content types, properties and block editors; verify exact role/approval workflow requirements.
records.api_headless: Opt-in Content Delivery API with JSON item/route and collection/query endpoints, cultures, filters, sorting, preview and API-key configuration.
records.maintenance_security: Active release activity through 2026-10-14, including 13.x and 17.x; multiple advisories through 2026-10-06, including protected-content exposure. Verify fixed releases and support branch.
records.arabic_rtl: No verified native Arabic RTL backoffice evidence.
records.license_notes: Core MIT grant does not extend to separate paid cloud, commercial products, or closed-source add-ons.
records.score_breakdown: 18/20 CMS fit; 13/15 architecture; 14/15 maintenance; 10/15 security; 9/10 docs/tests; 10/10 license; 3/5 operations; 4/5 APIs; 0/5 Arabic/RTL.

records.name: Drupal
records.cms_type: Structured traditional editorial CMS with optional JSON:API/REST decoupling
records.content_model: Content types, fields, taxonomy, references, Views, multilingual setup, revisions, Content Moderation and Workflows.
records.api_headless: Core JSON:API provides collections, filters, includes, pagination, sorting, revisions and CRUD; advanced translation/business rules require validation.
records.maintenance_security: Drupal 11.4.6 and 10.6.16 production-ready releases listed; 10.6 security support stated to end December 2026. Core and contributed advisories must be monitored separately.
records.arabic_rtl: Arabic/current RTL editor and theme behavior unverified; found RTL instructions targeted unsupported Drupal 7.
records.license_notes: GPL commercial use is generally permitted; review contributed modules, themes, assets and service contracts individually.
records.score_breakdown: 18/20 CMS fit; 13/15 architecture; 13/15 maintenance; 10/15 security; 8/10 docs/tests; 9/10 license; 3/5 operations; 5/5 APIs; 1/5 Arabic/RTL.

records.name: Ghost
records.cms_type: Publishing/membership CMS with decoupled Admin and Content APIs
records.license: MIT core; service contracts and trademark/logo rights are separate.
records.content_model: Posts/pages, authors, tags, members, newsletters, subscriptions and free/paid access tiers; schema-first modeling not established.
records.api_headless: Read-only Content API and authenticated read/write Admin API support decoupled delivery/management.
records.maintenance_security: Active commits 2026-10-14/13; release-page order was ambiguous. CVE-2026-105679 affected versions through 6.64.0 and was fixed in 6.64.0; confirm exact release and support status.
records.arabic_rtl: No verified end-to-end Arabic/RTL support across editor, theme, member portal and email.
records.license_notes: MIT code license retains notices; official Ghost name/logo are trademarks. Ghost(Pro) service terms were not assessed.
records.score_breakdown: 16/20 CMS fit; 14/15 architecture; 14/15 maintenance; 9/15 security; 8/10 docs/tests; 10/10 license; 3/5 operations; 4/5 APIs; 1/5 Arabic/RTL.

records.name: Directus
records.cms_type: SQL data platform and headless CMS; source-available, not OSI-approved open source
records.license: Current main LICENSE is Monospace Sustainable Core License 1.0 (MSCL-1.0-GPL); historical v11.15.1 uses BSL 1.1.
records.content_model: SQL collections/tables, fields, relations, assets, permissions and workflows; editorial approvals, scheduling, localization and preview need a proof of concept.
records.api_headless: Generated REST/GraphQL APIs and Studio overlay for existing/new SQL databases; custom frontend is separate.
records.maintenance_security: Release page showed v12.4.1/v12.4.0 as of 2026-10-14; multiple 2026 high/critical advisories require exact version-to-fix mapping.
records.arabic_rtl: Native Arabic Studio localization and genuine RTL layout were not verified.
records.license_notes: Check exact tag and grant/contract: MSCL competitive-use restrictions and key terms are material; historical BSL contains version-specific terms and change date. Do not treat as OSI-approved open source or transfer one release's terms to another.
records.score_breakdown: 17/20 CMS fit; 14/15 architecture; 14/15 maintenance; 10/15 security; 8/10 docs/tests; 5/10 license; 4/5 operations; 5/5 APIs; 0/5 Arabic/RTL.

records.name: KeystoneJS 6
records.content_model: Code-defined lists, fields, access rules, hooks, generated Admin UI; basic publishing can be composed, but a complete editorial workflow is not established.
records.api_headless: GraphQL is the main generated CRUD API; no first-party REST delivery API was verified.
records.maintenance_security: Commits through 2026-09-14, but formal release page displayed packages through 2025; advisories include maxTake/filter bypasses. Verify package version and patches.

records.license_notes: MIT rights subject to notice retention; independently assess dependencies and hosting terms.

records.name: Joomla CMS
records.cms_type: Traditional integrated PHP editorial CMS with optional Web Services API
records.license: Exact checked LICENSE.txt is GPLv2; README states GPLv2-or-later.
records.content_model: Articles/categories, tags, custom fields, language associations, access levels, publishing states/schedules and version history.
records.api_headless: Web Services API supports JSON content endpoints and GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE; opened guide targets 4.4, so validate on 6.2.
records.maintenance_security: Stable 6.2.0 published 2026-10-13; multiple 2026 advisories and fixes for access control, authentication, XSS, upload and CORS.
records.arabic_rtl: Official language packs and RTL calendar fixes are positive signals; complete Arabic editing/theme/extensions remain untested.
records.license_notes: Review extensions, assets and dependencies individually; service and trademark boundaries are separate.
records.score_breakdown: 17/20 CMS fit; 12/15 architecture; 12/15 maintenance; 9/15 security; 8/10 docs/tests; 9/10 license; 3/5 operations; 2/5 APIs; 2/5 Arabic/RTL. Correct sum: 74/100.
